purpose.summary: Source-preserved POGS reference IDs, labels, categories, conditions, and option lists used by the POGS form and payload mappings.
rules: Do not invent IDs that are absent from this artifact or another explicitly confirmed POGS reference source.
Preserve category-to-condition hierarchy where the POGS checkbox UI is hierarchical.
The clinical semantic layer decides what a clinical concept means; this artifact only supplies valid POGS reference values.
pogs-form-rules.json determines when each reference-backed field is applicable or required.

source.type: POGS frontend bundled reference data supplied during local reverse engineering
source.productionPolicy: Pin/verify against the exact locally running POGS build before enabling unattended batch writes.

knownConfirmedSpecialValues.note: Examples are included only because the IDs are directly present in the source tree; they are not automatic clinical mappings.

usageContract.lookupById: Validate that a candidate ID exists in the expected reference set and, for hierarchical sets, under the expected category.
usageContract.lookupByLabel: May be used for deterministic exact/normalized label matching, but clinical synonym resolution belongs to the semantic/AI extraction layer.
usageContract.hiddenEntries: Preserve source hidden flags. Hidden entries may exist in stored historical cases but should not be newly selected unless the current running POGS UI permits them.
usageContract.others: An 'Others' reference ID does not authorize arbitrary auto-mapping. Populate free-text companion fields only when the corresponding POGS UI rule is confirmed.
usageContract.regression: Reference-data changes should be regression-tested before promotion.

knownGaps.detail: Vacuum and forceps lists are included. The CS indication source is very large and should be exported/verified separately before unattended production mapping.
Conditional form behavior exists, but the complete current option dictionaries were not recovered as a stable confirmed reference set in this extraction.
Frontend exposes neonatal_causeofdeath and nested cause-of-death conditions. Add after confirming which neonatal status values activate them.
Stage value lists exist in the frontend, but category-specific stage applicability must remain coupled to confirmed gyne mapping rules.
